must_fix: ChargeHi, about 0.32-0.48 s (and every Lo/Hi blend above about 88 % charge): the pouch stalls over the head and drifts backwards. HI_WHIP = 65 is above the 57.3 deg limit where the whirl stays forward-moving: d(theta)/ds = 360 + 2*pi*65*cos(2*pi*s) goes negative for s = 0.42..0.58. Theta runs 92 -> 90 -> 88 deg, so the sheet frames at 0.32 and 0.48 are identical, and the pouch then crams about 270 deg into the last 0.32 s. It reads as hoist, hover, yank, not a taut, fast whirl, and the top of the circle, which is the part the game camera sees best, is now SLOWER than ChargeLo. Fix: set HI_WHIP to 20-30 so the pouch always moves forward (at least about 170 deg per loop at the top). Get the extra intensity elsewhere: hand circle rh 0.52 -> about 0.65-0.7 with the right arm more extended, a bigger body pump per revolution timed to the bottom pass (yaw amplitude 9 -> about 12 deg, drop pulse 0.10 -> about 0.15), and keep the 8x hand tremor. Keep the same 1-revolution phase as ChargeLo.

Fire, 0.00-0.12 s: the final whirl loses its momentum. The pouch sits almost still at the bottom right; the front and track sheet frames at 0.00, 0.05 and 0.10 are nearly identical. It moves at about 14 studs/s, against about 30 on average and about 65 at the bottom in ChargeHi, because psi_pre starts at a*|PSI0|/FireAt = only 100 deg/s. The whole final swing then covers just 120 deg in 0.30 s (400 deg/s on average), slower than the charge whirl it is meant to crown. A whirled sling cannot park at the bottom and restart. Fix: in psi_pre raise a from 0.25 to about 0.65-0.7 and lower p from 3.6 to about 2.5 (start about 270 deg/s, release about 600 deg/s). Then retune the beta/P keys at 0.05-0.25 to the new psi so the rise toward the camera and the overhand arc stay the same shape. Alternatively, shorten FireAt to about 0.22. Let the body coil (root yaw 5 -> -6 deg, waist yaw -> -16 deg, 0.05-0.20 s) carry the anticipation, not a stop of the pouch.

must_fix: LEFT UPPER ARM IS INSIDE THE CHEST in ChargeLo, ChargeHi and every aimed Fire key (f0-f16, 0.00-0.53 s). The LeftUpperArm block sits about 0.5 studs inboard of the left shoulder joint (torso-local +0.44..+0.56 x) and 0.35-0.48 studs deep inside UpperTorso. Only the forearm shows, coming out of the sternum. Cause: left_elbow=(-0.3,-1.0,-0.3) has a -Y pole, and this solver bows the elbow AWAY from the pole, so the R15 upper-arm block flips 180 deg inward. Fix: change aim()'s default left_elbow to an up pole such as (0.0, 1.0, 0.0) or (-0.3, 1.0, 0.3). I tested it in-memory: left arm in the torso goes from 0.42 to 0.00 at ChargeHi and from 0.35 to 0.06 at ChargeLo, and the Grip2 gap stays 0.05. Re-pole the Fire in-betweens 'mid' (frame 21, (-0.4,-1,-0.05)) and 'mid2' (frame 24, (-0.45,-1,0.1)) the same way.

READY CARRY IS JAMMED INTO THE BODY. The same pose is used by Fire 0.73-1.30 s ('lower' key frame 26 and the end key 39). The crossbow stock around the grip is up to 0.46-0.50 studs inside UpperTorso and 0.2 into the Head. The left arm reaching across to the right hip is 0.48 inside the chest; pole changes alone only get it to 0.25. With elev -35 the butt stock rises to y about 1.67 at x about 1.2, so from the pad camera it sits as a black box over the back of the head in every Ready tile of sheet_game. Fix in ready(): move the grip forward and out, from L.hold((0.7,-0.3,-0.55)) to about (0.85,-0.35,-1.05). Flatten elev from -35 to about -18 and keep yaw about 28 and roll -14. This puts the stock in front of the right hip/ribs with the butt below shoulder height (y < 0.9), and Grip2 lands in front of the belly. Then use an up left pole such as (0.0, 1.0, -0.5). Target: zero launcher overlap with UpperTorso/Head, left arm out of the torso, and a clean head silhouette from the game camera. Apply the same numbers to the 'lower' key.

CROSSBOW STRING/LIMB V CUTS INTO THE HEAD at ChargeHi and Fire 0.00-0.13 s (the fire frame). It is about 0.28 studs into the head's front-top-left corner, at launcher-local x -0.75, 0.4 forward of the grip, rail height. Cause: at depth 1 the head drops 0.6 and moves forward to x about -1.0, while the seat drops only 0.27. From the pad camera the orange string is drawn across the head in the red-bordered frame. Fix: at depth 1 keep the head about 0.3 further from the string. Either soften the extra forward lean (aim_body lean -10-6*depth to about -10-3*depth) or drop the seat less (1.95-0.3*depth to about 1.95-0.15*depth). Keep the 0.45 deeper hip drop so ChargeHi still reads stronger than ChargeLo.

must_fix: All clips, most visible in ChargeLo/ChargeHi/Fire: the right arm passes through the chest. The RightUpperArm block sits 0.23-0.42 studs inside the UpperTorso in every exported frame (Ready 73/73, ChargeLo 25/25, ChargeHi 25/25, Fire 37/37). In sheet_game it shows as a tan wedge poking backward out of the blue torso at mid-chest in every charge and fire frame. A render with the launcher hidden confirms it is the right upper arm. Cause: the pistol-grip target is at x~0.3, inside the torso's width, and the arm is straight, so the upper arm swings DOWN and INWARD across the belly (shoulder (0.94,0.45,-0.36) to elbow joint (0.56,-0.37,-0.54)). Fix: move the grip target out under the right shoulder, x ~0.75-0.9 instead of 0.3-0.44. Apply it to charge() `at` (build.py line 247), the Fire squeeze/fire/kick/buzz keys and TAIL `at` values (lines 298-341) and the Ready carry (line 199, 0.36 to ~0.8), so the upper arm travels FORWARD rather than across the body. Re-check with a launcher-hidden render from the game camera: no tan corner should stick out of the torso.

All clips: both arms are locked straight at full reach. LeftLowerArm is the identity rotation (0 deg elbow) in all 160 exported frames, and RightLowerArm in 138/160. Shoulder-to-wrist is 1.66 studs, which is the IK reach limit, in every key pose. This is the only launcher in the set with a never-bending left elbow. It reads as stiff 'zombie arms' reaching forward (obvious from behind-left) and leaves the left hand stretched just short of Grip2 (gap 0.08-0.13). The Ready docstring even promises 'elbow bent'. Fix: bring the gun 0.2-0.3 studs closer to the shoulders in Ready, charge and Fire. Either pull the grip back toward the body (while keeping the rear ring off the face), or lean the chest 5-8 deg further over the gun (waist_bend more negative) and turn the chest a few degrees right (waist_yaw more negative) during charge so the left shoulder comes forward. Aim for about 30-60 deg left-elbow bend and 20-40 deg right-elbow bend, with the elbows pointing down and outward.

ChargeHi (all 24 frames): the right elbow flips between straight and bent on alternate frames: 0,12,0,16,17,16,14,22,7,15,5... deg. The buzzed IK target keeps crossing the full-reach limit, so the forearm snaps on its own. That is the 'arms flailing against the gun' the design meant to avoid, and the gun buzz becomes irregular. Once the reach margin from the previous fix is in place, keep every buzz extreme at least 0.15 studs inside reach so the elbow angle changes by less than ~3 deg per frame, and the body, arms and gun shake as one piece.

must_fix: ChargeHi, 0.13-0.40 s (frames 4-12) and 0.50-0.77 s (frames 15-23): the RIGHT elbow flips between fully straight and bent on back-to-back frames. The exported RightLowerArm bend reads 61,76,84,49,74,61,0,52,0,46,60,0,64 (frames 0-12). The LEFT elbow is locked at 0 deg for frames 5-11, then pops to 35-48 deg (frames 12, 15, 19-20, 23). Cause: both arms are at full reach, and the root/waist tremble crosses the IK reach limit, so the elbow jumps about 0.3 studs in and out each frame on the arm that faces the pad camera. That reads as broken IK, not trembling. Fix in charge_params at d=1: bring the grip about 0.2 studs closer to the shoulders (az -2.20 -> about -1.95, ay -1.63 -> about -1.45, ax 0.87 -> about 0.95). Halve the lurch reach terms (az -0.08*gk, ax -0.06*gk). Move part of the tremble off the root yaw/waist (2.0*a*s[3], 2.0*a*s[0]) onto the launcher 'at' / elev offsets. Target: right elbow bend 25-80 deg on every frame, left elbow at least 15 deg on every frame, no elbow changing more than 15 deg between frames, left gap <= 0.1.

ChargeLo, frames 6-10 and 18-21 (0.20-0.33 s, 0.60-0.70 s): the same problem, milder. The left elbow goes 23 -> 0 -> 0 -> 0 -> 17 and 40 -> 23 -> 0 -> 22, locking straight at full reach during the lurch. Apply the same grip pull-in at d=0 so the left elbow keeps at least 15 deg bend throughout. Lo and Hi must still share the same phase.

Fire, 0.27-0.43 s (frames 8-13): the left arm folds flat and then snaps straight. LeftLowerArm bend reads 0, 23, 86, 142, 95, 0, including a 95 deg single-frame snap from 0.40 to 0.43 s and a 74 deg LeftUpperArm jump at frame 11 -> 12. It folds again to 138 deg in frames 20-28. Preferred fix, which also sells 'arms thrown up': let the left hand release Grip2 from about 0.27 s and fling the left arm up and back, free and above the head, at the 0.43 s peak. Re-grab Grip2 at about 0.93 s (frame 28). Otherwise, add in-between keys at frames 11-12 and 20-24 steering lex/ley/lez so the left elbow stays under about 100 deg and changes less than 25 deg per frame.
